title: Simulation state assignment
statement: For a configuration of a $k$-work-tape Turing machine with Boolean input, assign a simulation state as follows: if the machine has internal state $q$, the assigned state is the simulation state corresponding to $q$. If the machine is halted and $k>0$, assign the cleaning state for tape $0$ in the marking phase; if it is halted and $k=0$, assign no state.
hypotheses_covered: The machine is either in an internal state or halted
